name: Bodyguard2
source:
The request Shin Munakata got this time was about a hot idol.
It was about Narita Chitose, who just got a threatening letter.
Who could've sent it? And what's up with that older idol who vanished?
What's the real mystery here?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ208218.html/]dlsite[/url]]
